title: tooling(pm): ci-failure.mjs's roster banner, job-log line and substitute line say the member rows are 'listed above' when only the aggregator's row is listed
body:
Filing gate ①: a defect with a named landing point. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 (#6023, `session_012zwsLMxQBwHUYJgPyrpEvx`) from #23305's dev report and this seat's review of PR #23337. Triage may re-grade it on first touch. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` execution seat. **Surface:** `scripts/pm/ci-failure.mjs` (three render sites) and its self-test only.

## What was measured

`node scripts/pm/ci-failure.mjs --run 38411694784` was run at PR #23337's head `e29bf95658`. The only failing row it lists is the aggregator's (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `115353240189`). Three generic sentences still tell the reader the member rows are above:

| Site | Text |
|---|---|
| `render()`'s ROSTER JOB banner | "The answer is in those members' rows, listed above" |
| `sayLog`'s roster branch | "a verdict about the member jobs listed above, whose own rows already carry their assertions" |
| `renderSubstitute`'s roster line | "the member row(s) named above carry the answer, each with its own substitute" |

These lines were already false for this run before PR #23337. That PR made the per-lane line correct ("NOT listed above", with the check-run id and URL). The generic sentences around it still point to rows that are not printed.

## What done looks like

- Each of the three sentences says "listed above" only when at least one member row is listed in the failing list. Otherwise it points to the per-lane lines, which carry the check-run id and URL.
- One self-test case pins the superseded shape (the #23305 fixture): none of the three sentences claims a row above.
- A control case pins the shape where a member row IS listed: the sentences keep their current text.
- ⛔ No new gate.

**Workload:** XS. Same family as #23249, #23223 and #23305, all on the same file.

## 四维(业务立场)

- 长远合理性:报告的每句话与它实际打印的行一致,分诊工具不自相矛盾。
- 实际业务拉动:main 红时席位第一步就读这份报告;指向不存在的行,等于让席位重新手翻日志。
- 防 AI 犯错:AI 席位按「listed above」去找行时不会找空。
- 创业阶段不扩散:三句措辞随条件分支,一条自测;不加门禁。

Dedupe: this file's open and closed cards since 2026-10-01 are #23249, #23223 and #23305. None of them is these three sentences. Dedupe words: ci-failure roster banner listed above; member rows not listed superseded; roster substitute each with its own substitute.
